FlowerPainter.Roads.Name: Roads
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.pattern.Tool: How the streets are laid out inside the area.
Straight streets in a regular grid, aligned with the longest side of the area.
A collector along the area with branches ending in pairs of cul-de-sacs.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.pattern.organ: Winding streets with cul-de-sacs and a few loops, like a suburban subdivision.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.pattern.conto: Streets follow the terrain's contour lines, linked by gentle uphill roads. Needs sloped terrain.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.pattern.mixed: A radial centre with a roundabout, surrounded by organic streets.
Widely spaced collectors with a looping local street inside each large block.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.pattern.super: Collectors around groups of 3 × 3 blocks with car-free streets inside.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.pattern.conce: Rings that follow the shape of the area, joined by connecting streets.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.pattern.radia: A central roundabout with straight avenues out to the edge, optionally crossed by circular rings.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.roadMix.Tool: Which road goes where, in one pick. It sets the street, avenue, local, roundabout and perimeter roads and their upgrades below; changing any of them makes it Custom.
The standard mix: Two-Lane Roads for streets, Four-Lane Roads for avenues, a Two-Lane One-Way Road around roundabouts.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.roadMix.quiet: Two-Lane Roads everywhere, even the avenues, with street trees and grass verges. Calm streets for houses.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.roadMix.alley: Narrow two-way Alleys between the blocks; Two-Lane Roads for the avenues and the edge.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.roadMix.pedes: Pedestrian Streets inside (service vehicles only); cars stay on the Two-Lane avenues and the perimeter road.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.roadMix.boule: Tree-lined Two-Lane streets and divided Four-Lane avenues with trees in the median.
Streets: Two-Lane + trees · Avenues: Four-Lane Divided + median trees
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.roadMix.downt: A busy core: Four-Lane streets, Six-Lane avenues and three-lane one-way roundabout rings.
The standard mix with bike lanes on every street and avenue.
Streets: Two-Lane + bike lanes · Avenues: Four-Lane + bike lanes
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.roadMix.count: Gravel Roads for villages and farmland; a Two-Lane Road for the through routes and the edge.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.roadMix.custo: Your own picks: choose each road below.
The road for ordinary streets (and the perimeter road unless it has its own pick). Automatic places a Two-Lane Road.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.localAsset.T: The road for cul-de-sacs and short local streets. Automatic uses the street road (a Two-Lane Road by default).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.localAsset.D: Dead ends and small side streets.
The road for avenues and collectors, the main lines through the layout. Automatic places a Four-Lane Road.
Wider main roads through the grid.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.roundaboutAs: The one-way road that circles a roundabout island. Automatic places a Two-Lane One-Way Road: two lanes in the ring direction, like the Four-Lane avenue that feeds it. Only used when the layout has roundabouts (Radial, Mixed, Grid avenue crossings).
The one-way ring of a roundabout.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.perimeterAss: The loop around the edge of a drawn or painted area. Automatic uses the street road.
The road around the edge of the area.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.pathAsset.To: Path used for the walkways and for the car-free streets inside superblocks. Automatic places a Pavement Path (dirt trails take a trail path when your playset has one).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.angle.Toolti: Rotates the layout relative to the longest side of the area.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.alignTerrain: Turns the layout so one set of streets follows the slope's contour lines.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.gridMode.Too: Size blocks by distance, or by a number of columns and rows that fill the area.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.gridMode.coun: A fixed number of columns and rows spread evenly over the area.
Number of streets across the area's length.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.gridRows.Too: Number of streets across the area's width.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.culDeSacs.To: Turns some grid streets into dead ends with a turning circle.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.culDeSacFreq: Share of blocks that get a cul-de-sac.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.culDeSacDept: How far a cul-de-sac reaches into its block.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.culDeSacStag: Alternates the side cul-de-sacs start from, block after block.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.capStyle.Too: Decoration placed at the end of every cul-de-sac.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.capStyle.gras: Turning circle with a grass island.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.capStyle.tree: Turning circle with trees in the middle.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.capSize.Tool: Size of the turning circle. Automatic matches the road width.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.capSize.xl.To: Extra large turning circle (not available in asphalt).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.avenueColumn: Makes one column of the grid an avenue.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.avenueRow.To: Makes one row of the grid an avenue.
Which column or row becomes the avenue, counted from the first street.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.roundaboutIs: Places a roundabout island where the avenue column and row meet.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.treeBranchSp: Distance between two branches on the same side of the collector.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.treeCulDeSac: Distance between two pairs of cul-de-sacs along a branch.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.loops.Toolti: Share of branches that join another street instead of ending in a cul-de-sac.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.variation.To: Another random layout with the same settings.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.contourLinkS: Distance between roads that climb from one level street to the next.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.avenues.Tool: Number of straight avenues leaving the central roundabout.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.loopCollecto: Distance between collectors; each large block between them gets its own loop.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.superblockZo: Size of each block inside a superblock.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.rings.Toolti: Number of rings. Fewer are built when the area is too narrow for them.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.concentricCo: Number of streets linking the innermost ring outwards.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.roundaboutRa: Radius of the central roundabout (reduced to fit the area).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.perimeterRoa: A road around the edge of the area that the new streets connect to.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.perimeterRoad: On for drawn and painted areas; off for picked blocks, which are already surrounded by roads.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.perimeterCor: Radius of the perimeter road at the corners of a drawn or painted area.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.connectExist: Joins new streets to the roads they meet or cross.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.avoidObstacl: Leaves out streets that would cross water, buildings or power line pylons, without leaving dead-end stubs.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.followTerrai: Roads follow the ground. Off: the whole network stays at the area's average height.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.edgeDepth.To: How deep the strips along the new streets reach into each block (used by zoning and other add-ons).
Trees along both sides of the streets.
Grass strips along the streets (not with wide sidewalks).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.streetBikeLa: Bike lanes on both sides of the streets.
Trees along both sides of the avenues.
Grass strips along both sides of the avenues.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.avenueBikeLa: Bike lanes on both sides of the avenues.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.NothingFits: No streets fit in this area with these settings. Try a larger area or smaller spacing.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.TerrainFlat: The terrain here is flat: the contour pattern has no slope to follow.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.ObstaclesAvoid: {0} road segments were left out to avoid water and buildings.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.GenerationFail: The streets could not be planned: {0}
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.InvalidArea: The area outline is not valid.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.Roads.Description: A street pattern for the area, connected to the roads around it.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.RoadsWithParks.Desc: Streets, with a park filling every block between them.
FlowerPainter.Recipe.RoadsWithZoning.Des: Streets, with zoning painted along every new street.
FlowerPainter.EdgeZoning.Name: Edge zoning
FlowerPainter.Zone.Type.Tooltip: Which zone the plots get; buildings of that zone grow there.
FlowerPainter.Zone.commercialLow.Tooltip: Shops and small businesses (low density commercial).
FlowerPainter.Zone.commercialHigh.Toolti: Department stores and shop towers (high density commercial).
FlowerPainter.Zone.mixed.Tooltip: Shops on the ground floor with flats above.
FlowerPainter.Zone.residentialMedium.Too: Apartment blocks of a few storeys.
Set by the Zoning feature: zone the whole cutout, however deep.
FlowerPainter.EdgeZoning.Control.zone.To: A specific zone (mods included) instead of the zone type. Cells already zoned keep their zone.
FlowerPainter.EdgeZoning.Control.depth.T: How deep the zoning reaches from the road (8 m per cell, 6 cells at most).
FlowerPainter.EdgeZoning.Issue.NoFrontag: No road runs along this area, so nothing was zoned.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.junctionSpac: On main roads (avenues): side streets join at most this often (m). Closer side streets end in a cul-de-sac before the avenue (with a footpath to it) or join their neighbours instead. 0 = every side street joins.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.walkways.Too: Footpaths that shorten walks: from cul-de-sacs to the next street or close, through long blocks and through the middle of grid blocks. 0 = none.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.walkwayStyle: Paved footpaths, dirt trails (a trail path when your playset has one, with worn ground painted along it), or a mix.
Dirt or gravel trails with worn ground painted along them (terrain paint is permanent).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.backLanes.To: Small lanes through the middle of the blocks, between two parallel streets (share of the blocks that can take one). Never onto an avenue.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.laneStyle.To: Paved alleys, gravel lanes, or a mix.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.laneStyle.all: The Alley road (or the lane road you pick).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.laneAsset.To: Road used for back lanes. Automatic places the Alley.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.tipStyle.Too: The road of the dead-end streets: the same as their street, gravel, or gravel at some of them.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.tipStyle.grav: Every cul-de-sac is a gravel road from its last junction.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.tipStyle.mixe: About half of the cul-de-sacs are gravel roads.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terrainFit.T: Follow contours lays the streets along the slope (grids bend onto the contour lines, winding streets steer by the hill, too-steep links go). Ignore terrain keeps the pattern strict whatever the ground does.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.terrainFit.au: Each pattern as it is (its own Align to terrain option).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.terrainFit.fo: Streets along the contour lines, gentle climbs between them.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.terrainFit.ig: The strict pattern, straight over hills.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.maxGrade.Too: The grade the layout aims to stay under (%). Steeper roads are marked in Design; Follow contours removes too-steep links where it can.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.preZone.Tool: Zones every cell along every new road with this zone once the roads are built. Cells you zoned before keep their zone.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.IslandsDropped: {0} road pieces ({1} m) could not be linked to the rest and were left out.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.NotConnected: These roads could not be linked to the nearby roads: connect them yourself after building.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.Steep: A road here climbs {0} %, steeper than the steepest road set for this layout.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.pattern.terra: Streets on the hill's contour lines, each on a level terrace as deep as its zone cells, with banks between and links up the slope.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terraceCells: Zone cells (8 m each) kept level on each side of a terrace street.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terraceLinks: How the roads between terraces climb.
Straight up where gentle enough, else a long diagonal; switchbacks only where nothing else fits.
Zig-zag legs joined by hairpin bends, climbing gently between two terraces.
One road winding round and up the hill, crossing every terrace.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terraceLinkS: How far apart the links up the hill are along a terrace street.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terraceAvenu: The links up the hill are avenues instead of streets.
A gentle cross-fall away from the bank so rain drains off (0 = dead level).
Rounded grassy banks, or steep straight faces like retaining walls.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.terraceBank.b: A smooth S-shaped bank with rounded edges.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Option.terraceBank.w: A straight steep face with crisp terrace edges, worn dirt on the face.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terraceBankS: No bank between terraces is steeper than this (50 % = 1 in 2).
Ground already flatter than this is never terraced.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terraceEarth: The deepest cut or highest fill the terraces may make.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terracePaint: Dry grass and worn dirt on the banks (terrain paint is permanent).
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.terraceTrees: Clumps of trees on the banks between the terraces.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.TerraceSteep: The hill is steeper than terraces this deep allow: they narrow in places. Fewer cells or a steeper bank fit better.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.TerraceEarthwo: The earthwork is capped at {0} m: in places the terraces follow the hill a little.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.TerraceFlat: The ground here is flat: the streets are laid in rows and nothing is terraced.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.DroppedObstacl: Street left out: it would cross a building, water or a pylon and no way round fitted.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.PerimeterBlock: Perimeter piece left out: a building, water or a pylon sits on the outline and no way round fitted.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.PerimeterOpen: The perimeter road does not close here: no clean way across the gap.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Issue.JunctionCut: Side street cut back from this main road: junctions here are kept this far apart.
FlowerPainter.Roads.Control.homeDepth.To: Zone cells along new roads when neighborhood landscaping is on. Each cell is 8 m; interiors become shared gardens.
